item.title: ‘Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration’: Here’s How to Watch the TV Special Online for Free
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[INTRO MUSIC]
Host: "Hey there, Disney fans! Welcome to our latest episode. We've got some magical news to share with you. To kick off D23 2026, Disney has brought together the original singing voices of some of our favorite Disney Princesses for a special concert event, 'Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration'."
[CUT TO MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "Imagine Jodi Benson as Ariel, Paige O'Hara as Belle, Auli'i Cravalho as Moana, and Lea Salonga as Jasmine, all singing together on one stage. The concert was filmed at Disneyland in Anaheim, California, and it's airing this Sunday, August 16th, at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC, Disney Channel, and Freeform. You can also stream it on Disney+."
[CUT TO MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "So, who's performing in this royal concert? You can expect to see Jodi Benson, Paige O'Hara, Auli'i Cravalho, Brandy, Halle Bailey, Lea Salonga, and many more. If you're a cord-cutter, don't worry, you can still watch for free with a few streaming services offering free trials, like DirecTV, Fubo, and Hulu + Live TV."
[CUT TO MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "And, if you want to get access to even more Disney content, you can sign up for Disney+ starting at $7.99 per month. They also offer a bundle with Hulu starting at $9.99 per month. So, mark your calendars for this Sunday, and get ready to join the ultimate Disney Princess celebration!"
[OUTRO MUSIC]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you in the next episode!"
